translationRepairs: His younger brother Hui, courtesy name Jingyou, was widely thought to surpass Xin in reputation.

世譽多欣 means worldly praise mostly favored Xin; the before text reverses the comparison and invents Hui surpassing Xin.
Recently He Jianchuo sent your letter; though I know it was in jest, I know you truly cannot pity me.
Recently I saw Chuo deliver your letter; though I know it was in jest, I know you truly cannot pity me.
何見綽 is 'saw Chuo', not a surname He or a compound Jianchuo; 何見 is the seeing, and 綽 alone names the courier (Wang Sengchuo).
When he saw his father's younger brother's wife he was often moved to grief and choked with sobs.
When he saw his maternal aunt he was often moved to grief and choked with sobs.
從母 is the mother's sister (maternal aunt), not father's younger brother's wife; drop the awkward parenthetical while keeping that sense.
Past noon he did not come—I was already weary with hope; now how can I stand? Examining myself, dim poison—no more human reason.
Past noon he did not come—I was already weary with longing; now how can I stand? Examining myself in dim anguish—I am no longer within human norms.
愒望 is weary longing, 惛毒 is dim anguish of grief rather than literal poison, and 無復人理 means no longer within human norms.
